headlines.title: Trump holds two rallies in critical Texas battleground
headlines.description: President Trump is holding two rallies in Texas where Republican Ken Paxton is locked in a tight race with Democrat James Talarico. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: GOP Sen. Lisa Murkowski endorses Democratic candidate in Alaska governor’s race
headlines.description: The Republican senator endorsed Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins over Trump-backed Bernadette Wilson a week before Election Day.

headlines.title: Unclear outcome from high stakes Israeli election
headlines.description: The opposition to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu showed strength in today’s election, but not enough to win power outright. Now comes likely weeks of negotiations to see who can form a coalition government. NBC News’ Chief Foreign Correspondent Richard Engel reports from Tel Aviv.

headlines.title: Grand jury declines to indict former Trump aide Cassidy Hutchinson, star witness of Jan. 6 committee
headlines.description: The failed indictment is one of many for federal prosecutors during the second Trump administration.

headlines.title: Alexander brothers, ex-luxury real estate brokers, sentenced to 30 years in prison for sex trafficking
headlines.description: Federal prosecutors were seeking life sentences for Oren, Alon and Tal Alexander.

headlines.title: Fed expected to hold interest rates steady as inflation tops midterm voters’ concerns
headlines.description: Officials believe there is plenty of time left to tackle inflation, allowing them to avoid making a move so close to an election.

headlines.title: White House tempers its tough talk on Canada trade as inflation tops voter concerns
headlines.description: Trump’s combative approach to Canada appears to be softening just days before midterm elections in which tariff-fueled inflation is a primary concern for voters.

headlines.title: They bought cabins to live on a cruise ship. High fuel costs got them kicked off in Cambodia.
headlines.description: Florida-based Villa Vie Residences said it was working to identify “temporary living arrangements” for people aboard The Odyssey, a 642-foot cruise ship.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: James Talarico faces off against Trump in dueling Texas rallies in election’s final days
headlines.description: Voter enthusiasm in Lubbock, a Texas city of fewer than 300,000, underscored the stakes of a close Senate race in what Democrats call their best chance in a generation.

headlines.title: GOP Sen. Lisa Murkowski endorses Democratic candidate in Alaska governor’s race
headlines.description: The Republican senator endorsed Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins over Trump-backed Bernadette Wilson a week before Election Day.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll roll back Biden-era methane rules for oil and gas companies
headlines.description: The EPA plans to ease regulations aimed at curbing methane leaks, Trump said. The potent greenhouse gas is a major contributor to climate change.
